add.description: Save a note by role; an existing topic is replaced

get.description: Show the saved notes of a role

remove.description: Remove a note by role and topic

roleOption.description: The role the note belongs to

contentOption.description: Text of the note; leave empty to write it in a dialog

saved: Saved the note for {role} with topic {topic}.
removed: Removed the note of {role} with topic {topic}.
